title: BalanceConfig
description: A balance profile, balance/<profile>.yaml (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §4.1, §6). Keys land with the code that reads them. x-unit names each value's unit and, for durations, its clock (CFG-5, CFG-9); x-hot-reload is the §6 HR column. The settings registry (Q-CFG-15, NX-390) adds x-category, x-audience (OPERATOR, TUNER or DEVELOPER), x-edit-role (ADMIN or NONE), x-tune (a sweep range {min, max, step, scale}, not validation, or null), x-source and x-status (PROPOSED, RULE_DEFAULT, VALIDATED or FIXED) to each key; scripts/gen_config_reference.py checks them and writes docs/specs/CONFIG-REFERENCE.md. Fixed values use minimum = maximum, not const: const generates a Literal that also accepts true and 1.0.

schema_version.description: File format version, unitless; the loader accepts only 1 (§4.4).

Campaign.description: Campaign clock, end conditions, timed objectives and momentum (§6.6, GAMEPLAY §9; NX-126). Durations are game time, converted to ticks at load.

time_limit_h.description: Game hours of running clock until the time limit ends the campaign, unit h of game time (Q-GD-29, Q-TEST-6).

strategic_node_kinds.description: Node kinds that count as strategic nodes: the denominator of victory_node_frac and of the score and Momentum node shares (GAMEPLAY §9, Q-GP-21, Q-DEV-21), unit node kinds.

victory_node_frac.description: Share of strategic nodes (AIRBASE, FOB, PORT) the coalition must hold to win, unit fraction (GAMEPLAY §9).

victory_hold_min.description: Game minutes the coalition must hold victory_node_frac without a dip, unit min of game time (GAMEPLAY §9).

objective_period_min.description: Game minutes an objective lasts before it expires, unit min of game time (GAMEPLAY §9, STATE-MACHINES 4.5). Hot reload applies from the next objective (Q-CFG-16).

objective_mode.description: timed: one system objective at a time; off: none (Q-GD-19). Set per campaign by the owner or an admin (Q-ALN-10).

average_weight.description: Points for a side's whole average share of strategic nodes over the campaign, unit points (STATE-MACHINES 4.4, Q-SIM-64).

final_weight.description: Points for a side's share of strategic nodes at the final tick, unit points (STATE-MACHINES 4.4, Q-SIM-64).

objective_points.description: Points to the coalition per completed objective, unit points (STATE-MACHINES 4.4).

night_progress_cap_nodes_per_h.description: While no viewer unit is live, the Static may flip at most one node per 1 / this many game hours; its capture bar holds just short of a flip until then and the Director launches no capture operation (Q-SIM-85, THREAT-DIRECTOR §5), unit nodes per game hour.

hq_capture.description: Whether the coalition capturing the enemy HQ wins the campaign at once (GAMEPLAY §9; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option); false leaves the hold and time-limit endings, unit switch.

idle_floor.description: The idle floor while no viewer unit is live (Q-GP-28, Q-GP-44, Q-CFG-16).

enabled.description: Whether the idle floor applies with no live viewer unit: the theater's forward airbase's capture bar is frozen while the coalition owns it, the coalition sanctuary's defense HP cannot drop below sanctuary_min_hp, and the defeat clock does not advance (GAMEPLAY §0 and §9; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option), unit switch.

sanctuary_min_hp.description: The least defense HP the coalition sanctuary may be reduced to while the idle floor holds (Q-GP-44, Q-TH-7); at most capture.defense_hp.SANCTUARY, unit hp.

objective_pick.description: How a timed objective's node is picked among the frontline candidates: uniform, one draw on the objective stream (GAMEPLAY §9, Q-CFG-16; the only value today, the key exists for later weightings). Objectives score for the coalition only either way, unit enum.

momentum.description: Momentum weights (Q-SIM-60): momentum % = nodes_weight x the coalition's share of strategic nodes + supply_weight x its supply fill. They must add up to 100.

nodes_weight.description: Weight of the coalition's share of strategic nodes, unit percentage points.

supply_weight.description: Weight of the coalition's supply fill, unit percentage points.

defeat.description: The coalition's defeat (Q-TH-7, GAMEPLAY §9, NX-124 part 3).

hold_min.description: Game minutes the coalition sanctuary's defense HP must stay at 0 before the campaign is lost, unit min of game time (Q-TH-7).

Air.description: Aircraft fuel and idle orbit (§6.1, NX-368).

bingo_reserve_frac.description: Fuel kept in reserve at bingo, unit fraction of the kind's fuel_s: an airborne aircraft returns to base once its fuel is at most the flight time to the nearest base it can land at plus this reserve (STATE-MACHINES §4.1, NX-368).

orbit_period_s.description: One lap of an idle airborne aircraft's orbit at its min_speed_mps, unit s of world time; the radius is min_speed_mps x orbit_period_s / 2 pi (SIM-CORE §4, NX-368).

landing_node_kinds.description: Node kinds an aircraft may land at (and bingo or rebase to), when the side owns the node (Q-SIM-38, NX-368, Q-DEV-21), unit node kinds.

radius_m.description: A ground unit this close to a node counts for its capture, unit m (GAMEPLAY §8, Q-SIM-57).

time_s.description: World seconds one capturer takes to fill a node's capture bar before the quiet-stream and garrison modifiers, unit s of world time (GAMEPLAY §8).

multi_unit_exponent.description: Diminishing returns: the capture time is divided by n to this power, n the weighted capturers in radius, unit exponent (Q-SIM-26).

quiet_floor.description: The quiet-stream multiplier on the capture time of the quiet_sides at 0 live viewer units, rising linearly to 1.0 at quiet_ref, unit multiplier (Q-SIM-26). Hot-reloadable (Q-CFG-16).

quiet_ref.description: Live viewer units at which the quiet-stream multiplier reaches 1.0, unit viewer units (Q-SIM-26).

min_time_s.description: The shortest a capture may take, before the garrison modifier, unit s of world time (Q-GP-4).

logi_weight.description: How much of a capturer a logistics unit counts for, unit capturer weight (Q-SM-7).

garrison_mult.description: Capture-time multiplier while a defender that cannot contest (parked air, an unarmed ground unit) is at the base, unit multiplier (Q-GD-32, Q-SM-8).

empty_base_mult.description: Capture-time multiplier while the owning side has no unit at the base, unit multiplier (Q-GD-32, Q-SM-8).

decay_per_s.description: Share of the capture bar that drains per world second while the capturers are gone, unit fraction of the bar per s of world time (Q-SIM-23, Q-SIM-57). Counted in millionths of a percent per tick, rounded.

min_progress_per_tick.description: The least a capture bar gains per tick while a side captures, however slow the capture time, unit millionths of a percent of the bar per tick (NX-125, Q-DEV-21). 1 means a bar always moves.
min_progress_per_tick.x-unit: millionths of a percent per tick

defense_hp.description: The most defense HP a node of each kind has (Q-SIM-71, GAMEPLAY §8): an owned node starts full, a NEUTRAL one at 0, and a node that changes hands starts at 0 for its new owner. A BRIDGE has none here: its hp is logistics.bridge_hp (NX-373).

sanctuary_repair_hp_per_s.description: Defense HP per world second that each friendly logistics unit parked at its side's SANCTUARY (no path, not Disabled) rebuilds there, from the sanctuary's infinite supply with no stock debit, unit hp per s of world time per unit (GAMEPLAY §9, Q-SIM-71). Counted in thousandths of an hp per tick, rounded.

uncapturable_node_kinds.description: Node kinds that are never captured: no capture bar, not a base for the Director's targets, not a timed-objective candidate, no defenses to rebuild for the Static board (GAMEPLAY §8, N-4, NX-373, Q-DEV-21); must include BRIDGE (a bridge has no owner or stock); SANCTUARY may be removed, which also makes a sanctuary a Director base and patrol point, unit node kinds.

requires_defenses_down.description: Whether a capture bar can start only on a node whose defense HP is 0 (GAMEPLAY §8, Q-GD-18; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option); false lets a bar start whatever the defenses, unit switch.

air_counts.description: Whether airborne aircraft count as capturers, each weighing air_weight (GAMEPLAY §8, N-3; decided rule as default: they never count, Q-CFG-16 option). They never contest either way; LANDED aircraft only garrison, unit switch.

air_weight.description: How much of a capturer an airborne aircraft counts for, read only when air_counts is true (Q-CFG-16), unit capturer weight.

quiet_sides.description: The sides whose capture time gets the quiet-stream multiplier (Q-SIM-26: the coalition only, a documented asymmetry; Q-CFG-16 option); empty turns it off, unit sides.

Combat.description: Combat (§6.4, COMBAT; NX-124). Only the keys the built parts read.

pk_cap.description: Highest hit probability: every shot can miss, unit probability (CB-4, Q-CBT-10).

track_quality.description: Pk multiplier by how the shooter's side knows the target (COMBAT §5.2).

painted.description: A target painted by a recon unit, unit multiplier.

full_pk_frac.description: Share of a weapon's range_m with the full range factor, unit fraction of range_m.

min_mult.description: Range factor at range_m, unit multiplier; it falls linearly from 1.0 at full_pk_frac.

pk_mult.description: Other Pk multipliers (COMBAT §5.2); the unbuilt factors are the registered 1.0 fallback FB-6.

terrain_masked.description: A NOE or LOW aircraft, or a ground unit inside a theater masking region, unit multiplier (Q-CBT-11, Q-FOW-3).

damage_state.description: Damage-state thresholds (CB-6, Q-GP-8): a unit is in the state when its hp is below the fraction of its kind's hp; they descend.

damaged_below.description: Below this hp fraction a unit is Damaged, unit fraction of hp.

mission_kill_below.description: Below this hp fraction a unit is Mission-kill, unit fraction of hp.

disabled_below.description: Below this hp fraction a unit is Disabled, and a facility's hp floors there, unit fraction of hp.

damaged_speed_mult.description: Top-speed multiplier of a unit at Damaged or worse; an aircraft never flies below its min_speed_mps, unit multiplier (CB-6, Q-SIM-65).

damaged_sensor_mult.description: Sensor-radius multiplier of a unit at Damaged or worse, unit multiplier (CB-6, Q-SIM-65).

min_damage.description: The least hp a hit takes off a target, however heavy its armor, unit hp (COMBAT CB-3, Q-DEV-21). 1 means every hit hurts.

assist_window_s.description: A shooter that landed a hit on a unit within this long before the unit is destroyed is an assist on its UnitDestroyed, unit s of game time (COMBAT CB-5a, Q-SIM-66).

disabled_timeout_s.description: A Disabled unit that is not a facility is removed after this long, unit s of game time (CB-7, Q-CBT-14).

crew_survival.description: Chance a crew survives the loss of its unit (DOWNED, else LOST), one entry per kind with crew above 0, unit probability; the unit's one roll on the combat stream (CB-8, Q-SIM-68).

ENEMY_ARMOR.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

ENEMY_CONVOY.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

ENEMY_FIGHTER.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

ENEMY_STRIKE_FIGHTER.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

GARRISON_INFANTRY.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

LOGI_TRUCK.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

STRIKE_FIGHTER.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

crew_marker_min.description: A downed crew stays a map marker this long, unit min of game time (CB-8, Q-SIM-68). Hot reload applies to markers placed after it (Q-CFG-16).

facility_indestructible.description: Whether a facility's hp floors at its Disabled threshold so it is never Destroyed (COMBAT CB-9, Q-GP-37; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option); false lets a hit that takes it to 0 hp destroy it like any unit, unit switch.

Fow.description: Fog of war (§6.1, FOG-OF-WAR FOW-5, FOW-6a, FOW-9, Tier 1; NX-150).

paint_range_m.description: A recon unit paints a target it tracks with its own sensor within this range, unit m (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 2 painted flag, Q-FOW-6).

mask_cell_m.description: Side of the square cell that terrain masking regions are rasterized to, unit m (FOG-OF-WAR Q-FOW-3, Q-DEV-21): a cell masks when its centre is inside a region. Finer than the SIGINT cell, which would blur a narrow region. Bounded so the raster stays a sane size (a smaller cell makes the loader build millions of cells).

masked_alt_bands.description: Altitude bands that terrain masking hides: an aircraft in one of them, inside a masking region, is seen only by a sensor in the region, and a weapon fired at it takes combat.pk_mult.terrain_masked (FOG-OF-WAR Q-FOW-3, COMBAT §5.2, Q-DEV-21), unit altitude bands.

sigint_cell_m.description: Side of the square SIGINT cell that blobs aggregate into and are drawn at, unit m (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1, FOW-2).

sigint_range_mult.description: A SIGINT blob forms within this multiple of a friendly radar site's sensor radius, unitless multiplier (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1, Q-FOW-7).

sigint_refresh_s.description: SIGINT blobs are rebuilt after this much running world time, unit s of world time, frozen while paused (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-5, FOW-9).

sigint_size_l_min.description: A SIGINT blob of at least this many units reads L, unit count; must be above sigint_size_m_min (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1).

sigint_size_m_min.description: A SIGINT blob of at least this many units reads M (fewer reads S), unit count; must be below sigint_size_l_min (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1).

track_every_ticks.description: Tier 2 tracks are computed on ticks where tick % track_every_ticks == 0, unit ticks (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-5, Q-FOW-6).

track_fade_s.description: A last-known track is dropped after this long untracked, unit s of world time, frozen while paused (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-6a, FOW-9).

Logistics.description: Node stock and trucks (§6.3, GAMEPLAY §5; NX-123 part 1).

node_max_stock.description: The most stock a node of each kind holds, unit stock units; a theater's start_stock may not exceed its kind's. SANCTUARY (and so the Static's rear source) is infinite by rule and has no entry (Q-SIM-49).

starve_threshold.description: A base is starved below this fraction of its node_max_stock, unit fraction; a truck never loads stock below it, so the floor is ceil(starve_threshold x max) whole units (GAMEPLAY §5, Q-GP-24).

stock_target_frac.description: Forward stock target (Q-SIM-100, Q-SIM-102, NX-389), unit fraction of node_max_stock: a base the side owns below ceil(stock_target_frac x max) gets a resupply job even when it is not starved (a stocking job), and a run to such a base (not starved, no damaged facility) loads only stock a source holds above its own target, else at the side's rear source. At starve_threshold or below there are no stocking jobs.

truck_cargo.description: The most cargo a truck loads, unit stock units; one global value for every cargo-carrying kind (GAMEPLAY §5).

unload_rate.description: Stock a parked truck moves into its destination per world second, unit stock per s of world time, frozen while paused (GAMEPLAY §5, Q-SIM-50). Counted in whole milli-units per tick, so it is rounded to 0.001 per tick.

rearm_rate.description: Stock a landed aircraft buys at a base per world second, unit stock per s of world time, frozen while paused (Q-SIM-51). Counted in whole milli-units per tick, so it is rounded to 0.001 per tick.

forward_deploy_min_surplus.description: Stock a spawn base must hold above its starvation floor, unit stock units, before a JOIN may forward-deploy there (GAMEPLAY GP-7, Q-SIM-54).

starved_loadout.description: What a base below its starvation floor fills a landed unit up to (Q-SIM-53).

fuel_frac.description: Share of the kind's fuel_s a starved base refuels an aircraft up to, unit fraction.

loadout_cost.description: Stock a unit's full loadout costs, unit stock units: debited from the base it forward-deploys at (GP-7) and the price of a full refill at a base (Q-SIM-51). One entry per kind that can spawn by JOIN or director; facilities are placed by the theater and have none. 0 for the cargo kinds, which pay by loading cargo (Q-SIM-49).

repair_rate.description: Hp a unit or facility at a friendly base of each kind repairs per world second, unit hp per s of world time, frozen while paused; SANCTUARY repairs free and every other kind spends the base's stock (GAMEPLAY §5, §5b, Q-SIM-68). Counted in whole thousandths of an hp per tick.

AIRBASE.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

FOB.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

HQ.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

PORT.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

SANCTUARY.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

facility_repair_hp_per_stock.description: Hp of a facility that one stock unit of its base repairs, unit hp per stock unit (GAMEPLAY §5b, Q-SIM-68); a unit pays loadout_cost x the share of its hp repaired instead.

facility_rearm_cost.description: Stock a facility's base pays for a full reload of all the facility's weapons, unit stock units, in proportion to the ammo share used (GAMEPLAY §5b, Q-SIM-69); free at a sanctuary.

ammo_loadout_share.description: Of a unit's loadout_cost, the share its ammo costs when the kind has both ammo and a fuel tank; fuel pays the rest (GAMEPLAY §5, Q-SIM-69, Q-DEV-21). A kind with no fuel pays all of it for ammo. Unit fraction.

starve_hp_drain_per_min.description: Defense HP a base below its starvation floor loses per game minute, unit hp per min of game time (GAMEPLAY §8, Q-SIM-71); 0 turns the drain off. Whole hp, carried across ticks.

defense_repair_hp_per_stock.description: Defense HP one stock unit unloaded into a node rebuilds, unit hp per stock unit (GAMEPLAY §8, Q-SIM-71), up to the node's defense_hp.

bridge_hp.description: The most HP a BRIDGE node has, unit hp (STATE-MACHINES §4.3, Q-SIM-101, NX-373): every bridge starts full; STRUCTURE fire from a unit striking it lowers it, and at 0 the bridge is down and its road edge is cut for path planning until it is repaired to full. Not a capture defense (capture.defense_hp).

bridge_collapse_radius_m.description: How far from a bridge's cut point, measured along its road edge, a GROUND unit (either side) on that edge is destroyed when the bridge falls, unit m (STATE-MACHINES §4.3, Q-SIM-112, NX-400): Destroyed with its cargo, the shooter of the dropping hit credited, before paths are rerouted. Aircraft are not affected.

tick_hz.description: Kernel tick rate, unit Hz; fixed at 10 by ADR-0002, validated, not tunable (SIM-CORE SC-2).

time_scale.description: World seconds per real second while the campaign runs, unit multiple of real time (SIM-CORE SC-2, CFG-9).

Tasking.description: Tasking Board (§6.7, GAMEPLAY §1b, Q-SIM-73; NX-374). Both sides' boards use these keys. Durations are game time, converted to ticks at load. Priority points are `priority.<job_kind>` x urgency (1.0 to urgency_max for a triggering condition; a stocking job's is below 1.0, stock_urgency) + priority_aging_per_min x game minutes waited.

reeval_every_ticks.description: A board re-evaluates (settles, generates, assigns) every this many running ticks (TB-6), unit ticks.

claim_lease_s.description: A claim with no progress for this long is released and the job returns to OPEN (TB-1, Q-ALN-23), unit s of game time.

expire_min.description: An unclaimed job expires this long after it was posted (Q-SIM-73), unit min of game time. Objective jobs expire with the objective instead.

priority.description: Base priority per job kind (Q-GP-20), unit points; keys are the lower-case JobKind. Repair-bridge joins with its job.

static_offense_min_tier.description: The lowest Threat Director tier at which the Static's board posts the offensive jobs it generates itself (a strike on a discovered site); below it the board posts none. The Director's own operations are not affected (Q-SIM-85, THREAT-DIRECTOR 5a).

urgency_max.description: The most the triggering condition can multiply a base priority by (Q-GP-20), unit multiplier; a triggering condition's least is 1.0. Only a stocking resupply job (stock_urgency, stock_front_bonus) runs below 1.0.

priority_aging_per_min.description: Priority points an open job gains per game minute it has waited (TB-3, Q-ALN-23), unit points/min of game time.

slots.description: Units a job needs (TB-4), by lower-case JobKind; resupply is sized from the missing stock instead (resupply_stock_per_slot).

resupply_stock_per_slot.description: A resupply job gets one slot per this much missing stock (max stock minus stock, rounded up, at least one), unit stock units.

resupply_slots_max.description: The most slots a resupply job gets, unit units.

defend_radius_m.description: A friendly base posts a defend job when its side tracks an enemy ground unit within this distance of it (Q-SIM-74), unit m. Urgency rises as the nearest tracked enemy closes: 1.0 at the radius, the cap at the base.

counterattack_window_min.description: For this long after a side loses a node, its AI garrison may take strike and assist-objective jobs against it (Q-GD-31, Q-SIM-74), unit min of game time.

capture_max_restarts.description: A CAPTURE job whose claimants are still driving when its expiry passes gets a fresh expiry at most this many times, then expires normally (NX-156, Q-SIM-84), unit restarts.

scout_post_interval_min.description: At most one new generated scout job per board per this long (the highest urgency, ties by key), unit min of game time (NX-156, Q-DEV-21).

scout_open_max.description: The most generated scout jobs a board holds at once (the highest urgency first, ties by key; claimed ones always stay), unit jobs (NX-156).

scout_cooldown_min.description: A scout job whose cell still holds a blob after it was DONE is not posted again for this long (Q-SIM-75), unit min of game time.

follow_station_m.description: Where a follower keeps station on its direct leader (Q-GP-32, Q-SIM-76), unit m: `escort` a ground combat unit ahead of a truck or convoy on the same road; `column` a ground unit behind a ground leader; `overwatch` the radius an aircraft orbits within over a ground unit; `wingman` an aircraft's distance off an aircraft lead.

escort_threat_memory_s.description: An armed follower treats a tracked enemy that fired at any member of its convoy or column this recently as a threat to the group and engages it (Q-SIM-76), unit s of world time.

escort_leash_m.description: The farthest an armed follower leaves its station from the nearest other member of its group to engage a group threat; beyond it, it returns to station and a threat that far is not chased (Q-SIM-76), unit m.

follow_hold_slack.description: A stopped leader's ground followers hold where they are while within this many stations of it, instead of closing in (Q-SIM-76, Q-DEV-21), unit stations (multiples of follow_station_m).

overfill_point_jobs.description: Whether a Recon scout's point job overfills like any other (true), or never takes more than its slots (false) (NX-379, Q-DEV-21), unit flag.

join_excluded_jobs.description: Job kinds a parameterless JOIN never takes for a new coalition unit (the unit can still take them through the board); [] excludes none (Q-GP-23, Q-SIM-94, Q-DEV-21), unit job kinds.

ai_jobs.description: Job kinds a coalition AI garrison unit takes by itself; any other kind not in ai_excluded_jobs it joins only once a COMMANDER-owned unit holds a claim on the job, or as a counterattack (GAMEPLAY §1b, Q-GD-26, Q-GD-31; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option). Must not overlap ai_excluded_jobs; INTERCEPT has its own rule and may be in neither (the loader checks both), unit job kinds.

ai_excluded_jobs.description: Job kinds an AI garrison unit never takes, even beside a player (Q-GP-45: escorting, Q-SIM-94: patrolling are the players' call; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option), unit job kinds.

human_displaces_ai.description: Whether a viewer's unit that finds a job's slots full takes the slot of its AI garrison claimant with the highest entity id (Q-TD-11; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option); false counts AI claims like any other, unit switch.

overfill_factor.description: When every job is full, a job takes units up to this many times its slots (TB-4, Q-DEV-21), unit multiplier; a Recon scout's point job overfills only with overfill_point_jobs.

scout_blob_runs.description: A SIGINT blob must stay in its cell for this many consecutive SIGINT refreshes before a scout job is posted for it (Q-SIM-75, Q-DEV-21), unit refreshes.

scout_urgency.description: Urgency of a generated scout job by the blob's size bucket (Q-SIM-75, Q-DEV-21), unit multiplier, from 1.0 up to urgency_max (a larger value is capped there).

strike_urgency_per_threat.description: A generated strike job on a discovered facility has urgency 1.0 plus this much per point of the facility kind's unit threat, capped at urgency_max (Q-SIM-85, Q-DEV-21), unit multiplier per threat point.

strike_max_scaled_slots.description: Each generated strike job gets one extra slot per idle armed coalition viewer unit, at most this many extra; 0 turns it off (Q-SIM-92, NX-380), unit slots.

strike_idle_targets_max.description: While idle armed coalition viewer units remain and no marked strike target is open, the coalition board posts strike jobs on known defended foe nodes, at most this many at once; 0 turns it off (Q-SIM-92, NX-380), unit jobs.

strike_idle_targets_min_tier.description: The lowest Threat Director tier at which the coalition board posts strike jobs on known defended foe nodes for idle armed viewer units; below it only the slot scaling applies, so a lone new viewer does not provoke the Director by itself (Q-SIM-92, Q-SIM-86).

patrol_max_nodes.description: The most front-line nodes the coalition board posts a patrol job on at once, nearest a node the other side holds first; 0 turns player patrols off (Q-SIM-94, NX-382), unit jobs.

patrol_orbit_m.description: An aircraft on a coalition patrol circles its node at this distance, which is also the clearance from a discovered air-defense ring it needs to take the job (Q-SIM-94, NX-382), unit m.

patrol_dwell_s.description: A coalition patrol job is done once a unit has been on station this long (Q-SIM-94, NX-382), unit s of game time.

order_dwell_s.description: An armed unit whose direct node order (JOIN with a node) has arrived holds that node and engages; the order ends, and the board takes the unit, at bingo or RTB, ammo out, a new order, or this long after it began holding (Q-SIM-110, NX-398), unit s of game time.

stock_urgency.description: Urgency of a stocking resupply job: a base below logistics.stock_target_frac that is not starved and has no damaged facility (Q-SIM-100, NX-389), unit multiplier. It must round to at least 0.001 and, with stock_front_bonus, stay below 1.0 in whole thousandths (checked at load), so a starving or damaged base always ranks first; the higher of the two urgencies wins when both apply.

stock_front_bonus.description: Urgency added to a stocking resupply job when its base is on the front line (held, capturable, with a road neighbour the side does not hold: the patrol rule, Q-SIM-94) (Q-SIM-100, NX-389), unit multiplier; stock_urgency + stock_front_bonus must stay below 1.0.

max_live_per_commander.description: Live personal units per commander, unit units (GAMEPLAY GP-1).

respawn_delay_s.description: Wait after losing a unit before the next JOIN, unit s of game time (GAMEPLAY GP-2, Q-ALN-5).

max_viewer_units.description: Live viewer (COMMANDER-owned, AUTO included) units before JOINs queue, unit units (GAMEPLAY GP-3, Q-ALN-9).

reserve_queue_max.description: Reserve queue entries before a JOIN is rejected RESERVE_QUEUE_FULL, unit entries (GAMEPLAY GP-3).

queue_idle_min.description: A queued commander with no JOIN for this long leaves the queue, unit min of real time (GAMEPLAY RQ-1, Q-SIM-12). Read by the runtime, which submits SYS_QUEUE_TIMEOUT; the sim never reads it (NX-371).

rebase_order.description: The explicit order an accepted REBASE leaves the unit with: HOLD, it takes no board job on the way or at the base until its commander's next order (Q-SIM-90; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option). The only value today: GOTO would never end for a truck that keeps its cargo aboard, unit enum.

GarrisonKinds.description: ENEMY unit kinds that garrison a base, in round-robin order; at least one.

Director.description: Threat Director (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §6.7, THREAT-DIRECTOR §2-§5a, Q-SIM-78, Q-SIM-81; NX-151, NX-155, NX-156). Durations are game time, converted to ticks at load.

window_s.description: The decision window: CP, provocation, tier and budget update once per window, unit s of game time (TD-1, Q-ALN-23).

unit_value.description: CP points of one currently tracked coalition unit, by kind; one entry per coalition-side kind in the unit catalog (the loader refuses a missing one); every other kind counts 0.

STRIKE_FIGHTER.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

RECON_UAV.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

LOGI_TRUCK.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

GARRISON_INFANTRY.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

ema_window_s.description: The EMA window of coalition power, unit s of game time (Q-ALN-23).

alpha_enter_cp.description: Smoothed CP at which the CP ceiling rises from PATTERN_OF_LIFE to ALPHA, unit CP points; 0 means the ceiling is never below ALPHA (THREAT-DIRECTOR section 3, Q-TD-1, Q-DEV-21). The loader checks it is below bravo_enter_cp.

bravo_enter_cp.description: Smoothed CP at which the CP ceiling rises to BRAVO, unit CP points.

exit_ratio.description: A level (CP ceiling or provocation) drops only below its threshold times this, unit fraction of the enter value.

min_dwell_s.description: The least time in a tier before it may change, unit s of game time.

start.description: The tier the Director starts a campaign in, with dwell 0 and both levels at their usual start values, so after the first minimum dwell it moves toward min(provocation level, CP ceiling) like from any tier (THREAT-DIRECTOR §3; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option), unit tier.

max_step.description: The most tier steps one move takes toward min(provocation level, CP ceiling) (Q-TD-1: one; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option); 2 lets PATTERN_OF_LIFE and BRAVO change in one move, unit tier steps.

half_life_s.description: The score halves over this long, unit s of game time.

escalate_threshold.description: Provocation at which the level reaches ALPHA, unit provocation points.

bravo_threshold.description: Provocation at which the level reaches BRAVO (above escalate_threshold; the loader checks), unit provocation points.

ai_shooter_mult.description: The share of a hit's weight that counts when the shooter is not a COMMANDER-owned unit (AI garrison, facility), on units, facilities and base defenses alike, rounded down to whole millionths; 0 means only people provoke (Q-TD-11; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option). Captures and scouts in the rear stay the players' alone, unit multiplier.

scout_in_rear_max_per_window.description: The most scout-in-rear notes (weights.scout_in_rear each) one decision window adds, lowest track id first (Q-SIM-79, Q-DEV-21), unit notes.

weights.description: Points per sensed or suffered action caused by a player-controlled unit.

unit_destroyed.description: A Static unit destroyed by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

unit_damaged.description: One hit on a Static unit (not a convoy or a facility) by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

recon_destroyed.description: An unarmed Static recon unit (a scout kind with no weapons) destroyed or knocked to Disabled by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-89).

recon_damaged.description: One hit on an unarmed Static recon unit by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-89).

convoy_hit.description: One hit on a Static convoy (a carrier kind) by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

facility_damaged.description: One hit on a Static facility by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

facility_disabled.description: A Static facility brought to Disabled by a player-controlled unit (replaces the hit's facility_damaged), unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

base_captured.description: A Static base flipped to the coalition by a capture with at least one commander in radius, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

scout_in_rear.description: A player-controlled coalition scout the Static tracks in its rear, once per decision window, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

redemption.description: Provocation of a channel-point redemption by class (Q-AI-9, Q-ALN-13); no redemption command exists yet, so the weights are read by `provocation.redemption_weight` only.

support.description: A support redemption (supply drop, respawn skip, queue jump), unit provocation points.

cosmetic.description: A cosmetic redemption (color, ping, shoutout, spectacle), unit provocation points.

budget.description: The most budget points one decision window can spend, by tier (Q-TD-5); also capped by the real surplus of the Static's bases.

pattern_of_life.description: Budget points per window in this tier.

alpha.description: Budget points per window in this tier.

bravo.description: Budget points per window in this tier.

max_spawns_per_window.description: The most new Static units per window (Q-TD-12).

max_live_units.description: The most live Static units by tier (Q-TD-12).

pattern_of_life.description: Live Static units allowed in this tier.

alpha.description: Live Static units allowed in this tier.

bravo.description: Live Static units allowed in this tier.

op_priority.description: Base priority of each operation of the catalog, by operation id (Q-TD-6, Q-SIM-78); exactly the catalog's ids (the loader checks).

target_value.description: Target-value multiplier by node kind; a kind not listed is never a target.

AIRBASE.description: Target-value multiplier of a AIRBASE node (Q-SIM-78).

FOB.description: Target-value multiplier of a FOB node (Q-SIM-78).

PORT.description: Target-value multiplier of a PORT node (Q-SIM-78).

SANCTUARY.description: Target-value multiplier of a SANCTUARY node (Q-SIM-78).

own_node_value.description: Target-value multiplier of a node the side already holds (REINFORCE_IADS aims at one), unit multiplier (Q-DEV-21).

weakness_min.description: The weakness multiplier of a node at full defenses (Q-SIM-78); the curve is linear from here to weakness_max.

stale_factor.description: Coefficient of the Recon staleness term, score x (1 + factor x s) (TD-5).

weakness_max.description: The weakness multiplier of a node with no defenses left; it rises linearly from weakness_min at full defenses (Q-SIM-78).

provocation_proximity.description: Multiplier for a target in the last provocation sector while the CP ceiling is one of proximity_tiers (Q-TD-4, Q-SIM-78).

proximity_tiers.description: CP ceilings at which provocation_proximity applies (Q-TD-4, Q-DEV-21), unit tiers.

half_life_s.description: Half-life of every threat-memory counter, unit s of game time (Q-ALN-23, Q-SIM-81).

factor.description: Coefficient k of the memory multiplier: RAISE 1 + k x c, LOWER 1 / (1 + k x c), c in events (THREAT-DIRECTOR step 4).

weights.description: Events one occurrence adds to its counter (THREAT-DIRECTOR section 2, Q-SIM-81).

noise_scale.description: The scoring noise: a candidate's score moves by up to this fraction either way, drawn from the `director` stream (Q-SIM-78).

adaptation_up_above.description: A ThreatAdaptation goes UP when its threat-memory counter is above this many events as the matching operation launches (THREAT-DIRECTOR step 5).

reinforce_damage_above.description: Share of an air-defense site's HP missing above which ReinforceIADS counts it damaged; 0 is any damage (Q-SIM-81).

escort_min_convoys.description: The fewest convoys an escort operation may be cut to when the spawn cap or live-unit room is short; below it the operation is skipped (THREAT-DIRECTOR step 6), unit convoys.

frontline_hops.description: A node is on the front when a node within this many road hops has another owner (PROBE's target_is_frontline); 1 is a direct road neighbour, unit hops.

idle_retire_s.description: A Director unit with no job and no path for this long is retired: removed, no refund (Q-SIM-84), unit s of game time.

max_ops.description: The most non-routine operations with jobs a tier runs at once (THREAT-DIRECTOR section 3, Q-DEV-21); null means no cap (the budget bounds the tier). Routine operations (those enabled at Pattern of Life) are never counted, so Pattern of Life has no cap key.

alpha.description: The cap at this tier, or null for none.

bravo.description: The cap at this tier, or null for none.

job_urgency.description: Urgency of the jobs an operation posts, a multiplier on the job kind's base priority (TB-3), from 1.0 up to tasking.urgency_max.

adaptation_down_below.description: A ThreatAdaptation goes DOWN when its threat-memory counter falls below this many events (THREAT-DIRECTOR step 5).

recon.description: Recon scouting (NX-379, Q-SIM-87, THREAT-DIRECTOR TD-5): a scout flies to a point of the sector, loiters there, then goes home.

loiter_s.description: How long the scout loiters at its point once it arrives; the job is done then and the scout goes home, unit s of game time.

loiter_radius_m.description: The loiter pattern stays within this distance of the point, which also keeps clear of every known air-defense ring by this much, and a last-known track within it counts as the picture of the point, unit m.

grid_m.description: Spacing of the candidate grid over a sector from which Recon picks its point, unit m.

memory_s.description: How long a grid cell that a Static sensor covered counts as freshly looked at: its staleness rises from 0 to 1 over this time, and the entry is dropped then, unit s of game time.

intercept.description: Static scout intercepts (Q-SIM-96, NX-382, THREAT-DIRECTOR 5a): the Static's board posts an INTERCEPT job for a coalition scout its view tracks near a node it holds.

radius_m.description: A tracked coalition scout this close to a Static-held node is watched, unit m.

reaction_s.description: How long a scout must stay tracked inside the radius before the board posts the intercept, at ALPHA and above, unit s of game time.

pol_linger_s.description: The same wait at Pattern of Life, unit s of game time.

leash_m.description: A garrison fighter takes an intercept only when the scout is within this distance of its home, unit m.

lost_s.description: An intercept ends when its scout has not been tracked for this long, unit s of game time.

decoy_blink.description: DecoyBlink timing (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-11, Q-SIM-82): a selected radar is dark this long, then emits again; it cannot blink again for the cooldown, counted from the start of the blink; at most one radar blinks per window.

dark_s.description: How long a blinking radar stays dark, unit s of game time.

max_per_window.description: The most radars that start a blink in one decision window, unit radars.

cooldown_s.description: How soon after it went dark the same radar may blink again, unit s of game time.

garrison.description: Garrison upkeep (Q-SIM-85): the unit kinds that replace a Static base's missing garrison units, by node kind, used round-robin (the kind the base has fewest of, ties by list order).

replace_per_window.description: Units a Static base below its garrison_quota buys in one decision window (at most its shortfall, at most max_spawns_per_window), unit units.

pol.description: Pattern of Life periods (Q-SIM-85, THREAT-DIRECTOR §5a); game time, converted to ticks at load, counted on the campaign clock so a pause freezes them.

patrol_slots.description: Units (idle ground garrison units of the base) one patrol job takes, unit units.

convoy_slots.description: Units (carriers) one Pattern of Life supply convoy job takes, unit units.

patrols_per_base.description: Patrols (one idle ground garrison unit each) a Static base has out at once per patrol period, unit patrols.

convoys_per_period.description: Supply convoys sent per convoy period, each to a different Static base, largest upkeep shortfall first, unit convoys.

offensives_per_period.description: Capture operations the Pattern of Life slot may launch per offensive period, unit operations.

convoy_cost.description: Budget points one Pattern of Life convoy costs, debited from the Static's surplus like an operation (a reused convoy is free), unit budget points.

convoy_kind.description: The ENEMY carrier kind of a Pattern of Life supply convoy (it takes a RESUPPLY job), unit unit kind.

patrol_period_s.description: Every this long each Static base with an idle garrison unit posts one patrol, unit s of game time.

convoy_period_s.description: Every this long one supply convoy runs to the Static base with the largest upkeep shortfall, unit s of game time.

capture_slot_tiers.description: The tiers at which the periodic capture slot (offensives_per_period per offensive_period_s, outside the window budget) runs (Q-SIM-85: Pattern of Life only; decided rule as default, Q-CFG-16 option); empty turns it off, unit tiers.

offensive_period_s.description: At Pattern of Life, one capture operation may launch this often, outside the window budget but paid from real surplus, unit s of game time.

retake_window_min.description: A Static node counts as lost for a Retake operation this many game minutes after it fell (Q-SIM-81).
